# AUB HANDOFF Analysis

## Assessment

| Metric | Value | Status |
|--------|-------|--------|
| oos_mean | 1.88 | ✅ Excellent (>1.0) |
| oos_min | 0.43 | ⚠️ Weak fold present |
| exposure | 0.47-0.84 | ✅ Healthy range |
| degenerate_folds | [] | ✅ None |

**Diagnosis:** Strong mean performance but inconsistent across folds. The 0.43 min suggests at least one fold is significantly underperforming while others compensate. Priority: stabilize worst fold.

## Next Commands (3 lines)

```
aub fold-report --lane 21b5700bf9943671 --run db08d79b484756ab --show-worst 3
aub sweep --base db08d79b484756ab --param ridge_alpha --range 1e-4:1e-1 --focus-metric oos_min
aub submit --if-improved oos_min
```

## Rationale

1. **fold-report**: Identify which folds are dragging down oos_min — need visibility before tuning
2. **sweep ridge_alpha**: Regularization adjustment often helps stabilize worst-fold performance without destroying mean
3. **submit --if-improved oos_min**: Only promote if we actually raise the floor (guards against mean-chasing at cost of consistency)
